recipes.name: Double Decker
recipes.hook: Two thin patties, three layers of bun and the pink sauce that makes it taste right.
recipes.verdict: The bun and cheese match the shop's. All the change comes from the mince and the sauce.
method: Stir the mayo, relish, mustard, paprika and a splash of pickle juice together. Rest it in the fridge while you do everything else.
Roll the mince into 50 g balls. Get a heavy pan very hot, press each ball flat with a spatula, salt the top and cook 90 seconds a side.
Toast the cut sides of all three bun pieces in the same pan.
Build from the bottom: sauce, onion, lettuce, cheese, patty, middle bun, sauce, onion, lettuce, pickles, patty, top bun.
Wrap each burger in baking paper for two minutes. It softens the bun and melts the cheese like the real one.

rows.label: Burger bun plus a thin middle slice
rows.measure: 1 bun, plus the base of a second cut thin

swaps.label: Use 5% fat mince
swaps.why: Keeps the beef and loses most of the fat. Salt the patties well.

swaps.label: Use light mayo in the sauce
swaps.why: You won't taste it through the relish and mustard.

recipes.name: Char Burger
recipes.hook: One wide patty, cooked hard on a hot grill, under cold salad and sauce.
recipes.verdict: Hungry Jack's fat figure is the outlier here. Most of the gap comes from the patty and the sauce.
method: Press the mince between two sheets of baking paper into a patty about 2 cm wider than the bun.
Heat a barbecue plate or grill pan until it smokes. Salt the patty and cook it 2 minutes a side so it picks up a char.
Toast the bun, then spread mayo on the top half and tomato sauce on the base.
Layer patty, pickles, onion, tomato and lettuce so the salad stays cold against the hot beef.

swaps.label: Use 5% fat mince
swaps.why: It dries out faster, so pull it off as soon as it browns.

swaps.label: Use light mayo
swaps.why: This is the single biggest fat source after the beef.

recipes.name: Beach Burger
recipes.hook: Two grilled chicken fillets, melted cheese and a sharp chilli mayo.
recipes.verdict: More chicken than the shop's burger and far less fat, even with full-fat mayo.
method: Pound the chicken to an even 1 cm thickness. Rub with oil, paprika and salt.
Grill on a very hot pan for 3 minutes a side until the thickest part reads 75°C. Put the cheese on one fillet for the last minute.
Stir the mayo and chilli sauce together.
Toast the bun, sauce both halves, then stack lettuce, plain fillet, cheesy fillet.

swaps.label: Use light mayo
swaps.why: The chilli sauce hides the swap.

swaps.label: Use reduced-fat cheddar
swaps.why: Melts a little less, so add it just before the fillets come off.

recipes.name: Hot Fillet Burger
recipes.hook: A crisp, peppery chicken fillet from the air fryer, with just enough mayo.
recipes.verdict: Energy lands close to the shop's, with less fat and more protein. The crumb and a bigger bun add some carbs.
method: Mix the spices and salt through the flour. Weigh the flour and crumb bowls before you start if you want an exact count.
Dredge the fillet in flour, dip it in egg white, then press it into the crumbs. Rest it for 10 minutes so the coating holds.
Coat with the oil and air-fry at 200°C for 12 minutes, turning once, until it reads 75°C inside.
Toast the bun, spread the mayo, and add lettuce and the hot fillet.

rows.label: Plain flour that sticks
rows.measure: from about 40 g in the bowl

rows.label: Dry breadcrumbs that stick
rows.measure: from about 40 g in the bowl

swaps.label: Use light mayo
swaps.why: An easy swap, and the fillet is the star anyway.

swaps.label: Spray oil only
swaps.why: Less even colour, but it still crisps in an air fryer.

recipes.name: Portuguese Chicken Roll
recipes.hook: Chilli-marinated thigh, charred on a hot pan, in a soft roll with hot mayo.
recipes.verdict: Nando's is already close to what you'd make at home. Only the two swaps really move it.
method: Mix the oil, most of the hot sauce, garlic, paprika and salt. Coat the chicken and leave it for at least 30 minutes.
Grill on a hot pan, smooth side first, 5 minutes a side, until it reads 75°C and the edges char.
Stir the rest of the hot sauce into the mayo.
Toast the roll cut side down, then fill with mayo, lettuce, tomato and the chicken.

swaps.label: Use chicken breast
swaps.why: Leaner but less juicy. Marinate it for the full 30 minutes.

swaps.label: Use light mayo
swaps.why: Mix a teaspoon of the marinade through to hide it.

recipes.name: Brekkie Muffin
recipes.hook: A round egg, a rasher and a slice of cheese in a toasted English muffin.
recipes.verdict: The shop's version is already small and lean. Its cheese slice is about 14 g, so a 20 g supermarket slice accounts for most of the difference.
method: Split and toast the muffin.
Spray a greased egg ring in a non-stick pan. Crack in the egg, break the yolk, add a splash of water and cover for 2 minutes.
Fry the bacon in the same pan until just browned.
Stack cheese on the hot muffin base, then the egg, bacon and top. Wrap in paper for a minute to melt.

swaps.label: Use reduced-fat cheddar
swaps.why: Melts well enough under a hot egg.

recipes.name: Pop Chicken
recipes.hook: Bite-sized thigh pieces with a salty, peppery crust.
recipes.verdict: Swap the deep fryer for an air fryer and the energy falls by more than a third.
method: Mix salt and spices through the flour. Toss the chicken through it.
Coat in egg white, then crumbs, shaking off the extra.
Lay in a single layer, coat with oil and air-fry at 200°C for 9 minutes, shaking twice.
Rest for a minute. The crust firms up as it cools.

swaps.label: Use chicken breast
swaps.why: Cook 2 minutes less so it doesn't dry out.

recipes.name: Oven Nuggets
recipes.hook: Ten tender nuggets of pulsed chicken thigh in a crisp crumb.
recipes.verdict: A bit less energy, much more protein and nearly half the fat.
method: Pulse the chicken with the salt until it just holds together. Shape into 10 flat pieces and freeze for 15 minutes.
Coat in flour, egg white and crumbs.
Spray with oil. Air-fry at 200°C for 10 minutes or bake at 220°C for 14, turning once, until they read 75°C.

rows.measure: from about 40 g in the bowl

rows.measure: from about 60 g in the bowl

swaps.label: Use chicken breast
swaps.why: Pulse it less, or it turns rubbery.

swaps.label: Spray oil only
swaps.why: Bake them on a wire rack so the base stays crisp.

recipes.name: Shoestring Fries
recipes.hook: Double-cooked thin fries. The soak and the second cook do all the work.
recipes.verdict: 190 g of raw potato cooks down to about the shop's 104 g. The gap is deep-frying oil.
method: Soak the cut potato in cold water for 30 minutes, then dry it completely with a tea towel.
Toss with oil. Air-fry at 150°C for 12 minutes until soft but pale.
Rest for 5 minutes, then air-fry at 200°C for 8 to 10 minutes, shaking twice.
Salt immediately, in a big bowl, while they're still hot.

swaps.label: Use 3 g of oil
swaps.why: They go more like wedges at the edges, still salty and crisp.

recipes.name: Burrito Bowl
recipes.hook: Lime rice, charred chicken, black beans and salsa, all in one big bowl.
recipes.verdict: GYG's bowl is already a fair meal. You save a little, and the swaps do more than the cooking does.
method: Rub the chicken with oil, spices and half the salt. Grill on a very hot pan for 5 minutes a side until it reads 75°C. Rest, then chop.
Fold the lime juice and remaining salt through the hot rice.
Warm the beans and char the corn in the chicken pan.
Fill the bowl with rice, then beans, corn, chicken, salsa, lettuce and cheese.

swaps.label: Use chicken breast
swaps.why: Cook it fast and slice it thin.

swaps.label: Cut the rice to 110 g
swaps.why: Add extra lettuce so the bowl still looks full.

swaps.label: Use reduced-fat cheddar
swaps.why: Grate it fine so it melts into the hot chicken.

recipes.name: Tray Nachos
recipes.hook: Chips, chicken and beans under a real layer of cheese, finished cold with salsa and avo.
recipes.verdict: The shop's plate carries 64 g of fat. Weighing the chips and cheese does most of the work here.
method: Rub the chicken with oil, spices and salt. Grill until it reads 75°C, rest and shred.
Heat the oven to 200°C. Spread the chips on a lined tray, then scatter over chicken, beans and cheese.
Bake 6 to 8 minutes until the cheese bubbles.
Spoon on the salsa, avocado and sour cream at the table.

swaps.label: Bake corn tortillas into chips
swaps.why: Cut 4 tortillas into wedges, spray and bake at 180°C for 8 minutes.

swaps.label: Cut the cheese to 30 g
swaps.why: Spread it thin and right to the edges.

swaps.label: Use Greek yoghurt for the sour cream
swaps.why: Stir in a squeeze of lime.

recipes.name: Home Pepperoni
recipes.hook: A hand-stretched base with a plain tomato sauce, compared at three large slices.
recipes.verdict: Domino's puts less on a slice than you'd think. A home pizza with a normal hand of cheese comes out heavier, and only the swaps pull it back.
method: Mix the flour, salt, sugar and oil with 40 mL of warm water per serve and 1 tsp of dried yeast per batch. Knead for 8 minutes and leave for an hour.
Blend the tomatoes and paste. Don't cook the sauce.
Heat the oven to its top setting with a tray inside. A three-serve batch stretches to one 35 cm pizza, cut into 9 slices.
Spread sauce, cheese and pepperoni, then bake on the hot tray for 8 to 10 minutes.

swaps.label: Cut the mozzarella to 30 g
swaps.why: Leave gaps on the base. The sauce shows through like the shop's.

swaps.label: Cut the pepperoni to 10 g
swaps.why: Slice it thin and spread it out.
